questions.q:
I don't like movies who has an unhappy ending.

[CGL Tier II 11/9/2019]
questions.s:
Correct Answer: who has

The word "who" is used to refer to people, but here it refers to "movies," which is an object, not a person.

The correct relative pronoun should be "which" to refer to things like movies.

Movies plural so verb have.

Corrected Sentence: I don't like movies which have an unhappy ending.

questions.q: Select the most appropriate pronoun to fill in the blank.
questions.s: "His" is a possessive pronoun showing that the students belong to or are taught by the teacher (assuming the teacher is male). It shows the relationship between the teacher and his students. "Himself" is reflexive, "its" is for non-human things, and "mine" is first-person possessive.

questions.q:
This is the student which won the first prize in the recitation.

[CHSL 10/08/2021 S2]
questions.s:
Correct Answer: who won

Corrected Sentence: This is the student who won the first prize in the recitation.

1. "Who" is the correct relative pronoun to refer to a person (the student) performing the action (won the first prize).

2. "Which" is incorrect because it is used to refer to things, not people.

questions.q: After / a long and fun-filled day / the children / slept themselves peacefully. (SSC CHSL Tier-01 24/05/22)
questions.s: The verb 'sleep' does not take a reflexive pronoun. The word 'themselves' should be removed.

questions.q: This is the sportsperson (1)/ whom I think has won (2)/ the much coveted prize. (3)/ No error (4)
o: whom I think has won
the much coveted prize.
questions.s:
After “I think”, the clause requires the subject form, because the verb “has won” needs a subject.
So “whom” (object) is wrong; it should be “who” (subject).

questions.q:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select 'No substitution required’


We have finished our work for the day, so let we go home early today.

[CHSL 11/08/2021 S2]
questions.s:
The correct answer is Option 2: let us go.

"Let" should be followed by the object pronoun "us" instead of the subject pronoun "we". So, "let we go" is incorrect and should be "let us go".

Correct sentence: We have finished our work for the day, so let us go home early today.

questions.q: Identify the type of pronoun bracketed in the following sentence.
questions.s: "Itself" is a reflexive pronoun because it refers back to the subject "the cat" - showing that the cat performed the action on its own body. Reflexive pronouns end in -self (singular) or -selves (plural) like myself, yourself, himself, herself, itself, ourselves, themselves. They're used when the subject and object of the sentence are the same.

questions.s: Superlative takes "that". सुपरलेटिव के साथ 'that' का प्रयोग होता है।

questions.s: Engineers ki tulna engineers 'those' se hogi, office se nahi. Compare similar entities: engineers vs those.

o: The article suggests that when a person is under unusual stress
you should be especially careful
to eat a well-balanced diet.
questions.s: The subject “a person” is singular, so the following pronoun must agree — he or she, not you.

questions.q:
She has been a member of this club since it's formation.

[CGL Tier II - 16/11/2020]
questions.s:
Correct Answer: since it's formation

  • "It's" is a contraction for "it is" or "it has", but here you need the possessive form, which is "its" to show ownership.

  • The correct word is "its" (possessive form), showing ownership: the formation of the club.

Correct Sentence: She has been a member of this club since its formation.

questions.q: He is as concerned as me / regarding / the examination schedule. (SSC Selection Post phase-X 28/06/23)
o: He is as concerned as me
questions.s: After 'as', the subjective pronoun 'I' should be used, as the sentence implies 'as I am concerned'.

questions.q:
Choose the appropriate pronouns for the given sentence.
When ______was a young girl,_______mother taught _______how to read.
questions.s: The subject “young girl” shows the person is female, so the pronouns must agree in gender and number — she (subject), her (possessive), and her (object).

questions.q: Q44. Q44. Whomever is responsible for this financial loss to the company must be held accountable.
questions.s: The pronoun serves as the subject of the verb "is responsible". Therefore, the subjective case "Whoever" is required.

questions.q: He is the only man I know ( who ) can laugh at himself.
questions.s:
After expressions like “the only man I know”, the correct relative pronoun is “who” because it refers to a person and acts as the subject of the clause “can laugh at himself.”
So “who” is already correct.

questions.q: Q7. 29. Banks that do not meet its priority sector targets are required to pay high penalties.
questions.s: 'Banks' plural subject hai, isliye plural possessive 'their' ka use hoga. 'Banks' is plural, so it requires 'their' instead of 'its'.

questions.q:
There are some members who haven't paid his subscription yet.

[ CHSL 19/10/2020 S3]
questions.s:
Correct Answer: his subscription yet

The subject "members" is plural, but "his" is a singular possessive pronoun.

The correct possessive pronoun for plural "members" should be "their".

Corrected Sentence: There are some members who haven't paid their subscription yet.

questions.s: दो फर्मों की बात हो रही है, इसलिए 'both of which' (दोनों ही) का प्रयोग सबसे उपयुक्त है।

questions.s: The comparison is between 'him' and the speaker. The object pronoun 'me' should be used.

questions.q:
Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select ‘No substitution required’.

It is important to be aware of what we eat as food choices play an important role and affect their lifespan.
questions.s:
The correct answer is 'affect our'.

Key Points

  • The given sentence is grammatically incorrect.
  • Here, 'affect our' should be used instead of 'affect their'.
  • The subject of the given sentence is 'we'. 
  • Accordingly, it should be followed by the same parts of speech. Hence, 'our' should be used.
  • Thus, the correct answer is Option 4.
     

Correct Sentence: It is important to be aware of what we eat as food choices play an important role and affect our lifespan.

Hinglish

  • दिया गया वाक्य व्याकरण की दृष्टि से गलत है।
  • यहां 'affect their' की जगह 'affect our' का इस्तेमाल करना चाहिए।
  • दिए गए वाक्य का विषय 'We' है।
  • तदनुसार, समान parts of speech का पालन किया जाना चाहिए। इसलिए 'our' का प्रयोग करना चाहिए।
  • अत: सही उत्तर विकल्प 4 है।

questions.q: Q26. My older brother, (a)/ which you'll (b)/ meet later, (c)/ is a dentist.(d)
questions.s: 'Which' is used for things or animals. For people, the relative pronoun 'whom' should be used when it is the object of the clause.
